speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
text: asked the Minister for Health whether there are stricter measures put in place to ensure blood tests cannot be forged for employment purposes.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Can I just check with Dr Intan Mokhtar if she is referring to prospective employees who are employed by the healthcare sector?

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
text: I think it was supposed to be directed to MOM.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: I suppose it would be similar with the other Ministries in that we would actually check against the authenticity of the certificate and, if necessary, even to verify with the institution that issued the certificate to the prospective employee.
